name: Casefile / Follow-Up
description: Central record of documents, notes, actions and follow-ups. Employee follow-up, case management and tracked interventions.
reference_use_case: Employee follow-up, case management and tracked interventions.
integrity_rule: Sensitive assessments and decisions require explicit governance.
antipattern: Do not transform a follow-up record into an automatic employment judgment.
design_question: What access, retention, provenance and decision boundaries govern this case?
situational_schema: A case centralizes meetings, documents, actions and assessments while keeping provenance and access controls.
